images.filename: Brixton Down Continental Boat express at Cambria Road Junction, near Denmark Hill geograph-2677227-by-Ben-Brooksbank.jpg
images.caption:
Down Continental Boat express at Cambria Road Junction, near Denmark Hill.
View westward from near Ruskin Park, towards Brixton and Victoria. The train is running from Victoria via the Catford Loop rather than the usual (ex-London, Chatham & Dover) route via Sydenham Hill. The locomotive is SR Bulleid Light Pacific No. 34101 'Hartland' (built 2/50, subsequently rebuilt 9/60, withdrawn 7/66 but preserved and now on the North Yorkshire Moors Railway). Cambria Road Junction Box is visible behind the train, controlling the loop off the Holborn Viaduct line at Loughborough Junction.
images.alt:

View westward from near Ruskin Park, towards Brixton and Victoria. The train is running from Victoria via the Catford Loop rather than the usual (ex-London, Chatham & Dover) route via Sydenham Hill.
